narrative.overview: L Cafe uses one restrained hospitality identity at three working speeds: Landing is an atmospheric reception, Menu is a fast customer lookup surface, and Admin is a calm operating workspace. Public pages share maroon, ivory, RTL typography, brand marks, and restrained motion; Admin adds paper surfaces and semantic status colors for production-backed work.
keyCharacteristics: Mobile-first Persian RTL across every surface.
Landing atmosphere, Menu scanability, and Admin operational clarity.
Maroon and ivory remain the brand anchors; Admin status colors are semantic.
Text and essential controls remain usable without decorative motion or WebGL.
Current source implementation is the visual authority; menu data is not.

rules.name: The Public Two-Hue Rule
rules.body: Landing and Menu do not introduce a third accent hue.

rules.name: The Semantic Admin Rule
rules.body: Admin status colors communicate system state and never replace text labels.

rules.name: The Bare Numeral Rule
rules.body: Menu prices remain exactly as supplied with no currency word, unit, separator, or inferred value.

rules.name: The Flat Public Rule
rules.body: Landing and Menu remain continuous canvases rather than centered page cards.

rules.name: The Fallback-First Rule
rules.body: Decorative effects enhance an already visible static structure; they never replace it.

dos: Do preserve RTL, visible focus, skip links, and 44px effective targets.
Do keep Menu search, category anchors, and fallback states in stable flow.
Do make Admin role, save, conflict, archive, and upload state explicit.
donts: Don't change managed menu data or fixtures for layout work.
Don't collapse the Menu product grid to one column on mobile.
Don't expose owner controls to cashiers or rely on UI hiding as authorization.
Don't reintroduce the retired maroon Menu card and rail system.
